purpose: Add periodic-element H/O/N roots to 366-position N184 analytical-cubit color overlay and retain five prior-named symbolic operators as color-state transformations
atomicNumberVsAddress: Periodic table atomic numbers H=1, O=8, N=7 are NOT range indexes; 122-member blocks are symbolic carrier addresses, not 122 discovered isotopes/elements.

operations.name: Gravity
operations.displayTransformation: Hue offset from root anchor halved; saturation, value unchanged

operations.name: Expansion

operations.displayTransformation: HSV saturation multiplied by 0.5; hue and value unchanged

strengthModel.semantics: HSV display brightness; not weak/strong nuclear interaction force

cubitBridge.association: 18 numbered cubit positions grouped six each for root H, O and N, while preserving seven original color packets as independent overlay
cubitBridge.addressRule: for slot position n, rootOrdinal=floor((n-1)/6); local=(n-1)%6; address=root.start+round(local*121/5)

limitations: Element names are periodic-table referents; this registry is symbolic, not a proposal that elements 119..366 have been verified.
Operants reuse the five names from the frozen prior model but have newly declared, optional deterministic RGB/HSV display algorithms; no claim of physical forces or chemical transformations.
Temperature labels 2K/1K/0K are symbolic only, not measured elemental temperatures.
The 18-to-366 map samples six addresses per root rather than enumerating all 122 within each cubit slot. The full root registry remains 366 positions.
The seven-band cubit display and three H/O/N gradient overlay are simultaneous different coordinate systems; neither overwrites the other.
The original 370 source palette remains defined with four non-root tail addresses; do not silently append a fifth address or overwrite the third orbit.
